content: Microsoft is working on an AI “super app” that combines Copilot’s chat, coding, and agentic capabilities. During an earnings call on Wednesday, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said the app will span “both consumer and commercial experiences” when it launches this year. “Copilot is evolving rapidly from chat to Cowork to Autopilots,” Nadella said. “This quarter, we are bringing these Copilot experiences together, including code, in one super app… This is a major step forward, and I look forward to sharing more soon.” Nadella’s confirmation comes months after a report from Fortune revealed that Microsoft is working on a super app that blends its Copilot chatbot, GitHub Copilot coding assistant, Copilot Cowork, and its agentic Autopilot system. Along with Microsoft, OpenAI recently revealed its new ChatGPT Work app, which combines ChatGPT and its AI coding tool Codex. Microsoft’s revenue jumped to $90 billion over the past quarter, with its AI and cloud businesses driving the increase.

chineseContent: 微软正在开发一款人工智能“超级应用程序”，它结合了 Copilot 的聊天、编码和代理功能。在周三的财报电话会议上，微软首席执行官萨蒂亚纳德拉表示，该应用程序在今年推出时将涵盖“消费者和商业体验”。 “Copilot 正在迅速从聊天发展到 Cowork，再到 Autopilot，”纳德拉说。 “本季度，我们将这些 Copilot 体验（包括代码）整合到一个超级应用程序中……这是向前迈出的重要一步，我期待尽快分享更多内容。”几个月前，《财富》杂志报道称，微软正在开发一款超级应用程序，该应用程序融合了 Copilot 聊天机器人、GitHub Copilot 编码助手、Copilot Cowork 及其代理 Autopilot 系统。 OpenAI 最近与微软一起发布了新的 ChatGPT Work 应用程序，该应用程序结合了 ChatGPT 及其 AI 编码工具 Codex。在人工智能和云业务的推动下，微软上一季度的收入跃升至 900 亿美元。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
